faqs.question: Can I repatriate rental income and sales proceeds abroad?
faqs.answer: Yes. Under RBI guidelines and FEMA regulations, rental income can be credited to an NRO account and repatriated up to USD 1 Million per financial year using Form 15CA & 15CB with CA certification.

faqs.question: How do you handle physical inspections if I live overseas?
faqs.answer: Our dedicated field team conducts 45-point bi-monthly physical audits, checks plumbing/electrical fixtures, and uploads high-resolution 360° photo reports directly to your Owner Dashboard.

faqs.question: Do I need to visit India to execute lease agreements?
faqs.answer: No. We facilitate digital biometric e-stamping and Power of Attorney (PoA) execution where permitted, enabling completely remote tenant onboarding.
